model_annotation: The bar chart illustrates the average performance across 11 datasets for different inference-based methods applied to standard and modified instruction-tuned models. The categories are listed on the horizontal axis, labeled "Base", "CORG", and "AdaCAD", representing different methods, and are ordered from left to right. The vertical axis is labeled "Average Performance" and ranges from 48 to 62, with a linear scale and tick labels at intervals of 2. Each category has a pair of bars, with the gray bar representing the "Standard" model and the blue bar representing "Ours". The "Base" category has a gray bar at approximately 58.8 and a blue bar at approximately 59; the "CORG" category has a gray bar at approximately 51 and a blue bar at approximately 59; and the "AdaCAD" category has a gray bar at approximately 53.5 and a blue bar at approximately 60.5. The bars are grouped by category, with the gray and blue bars appearing together for each method. The chart does not display any specific sorting order for the bars beyond their categorical grouping, and there is no visual emphasis on any particular bar.
